name: Match
definition: A single football fixture, described by its season, stage, date, the two participating teams and the number of goals each team scored.
scope: Match-level goal, draw and fixture-count analysis across leagues and seasons.

name: League
definition: A named national competition that groups matches and belongs to exactly one country.
scope: League-level comparison, league name lookup and grouping fixtures by competition.

name: Country
definition: The country whose national competition structure contains a league; it is the dimension used when a question scopes matches to a country such as Poland.
scope: Country-scoped match and league analysis.

name: Team
definition: A football club identified by a long display name, a short name and a team API identifier.
scope: Team-level identification, team named lookups and team attribute analysis.

name: Player
definition: A footballer described by a display name, date of birth, height and weight, and linked to dated attribute snapshots.
scope: Player-level identification, physical profile analysis and player attribute analysis.

name: Player Attributes Snapshot
definition: A dated FIFA-style attribute record for one player, holding the overall rating, the potential, the preferred foot and the individual skill scores.
scope: Player rating, potential, preference and skill-score analysis. One row is one snapshot, not one player.

name: Team Attributes Snapshot
definition: A dated tactical attribute record for one team, holding style scores such as build-up play speed and chance creation passing together with their categorical class labels.
scope: Team playing-style analysis. One row is one snapshot, not one team.

name: Season
definition: A competition period labelled by its opening and closing calendar years in the form YYYY/YYYY, so a single season label spans two calendar years.
scope: Seasonal aggregation and filtering of matches.

name: Match Date
definition: The calendar date on which a match was played, recorded as a datetime value; the month or year of a match is read from the leading part of this value.
scope: Calendar-month and calendar-year filtering of matches, independently of the season label.

name: Preferred Foot
definition: The foot a player prefers to use when attacking, recorded as a small categorical value.
scope: Filtering players by attacking foot preference.
aliases: prefer to use the right foot when attacking

name: Player API Identifier
definition: The API identifier that uniquely labels a player in this dataset and is used as the player reference from other tables.
scope: Joining players to their attribute snapshots and to match participation columns.

name: Player FIFA Identifier
definition: The FIFA-side identifier of a player; it is unique per player and one-to-one with the player API identifier, but comes from a different identifier system.
scope: Alternate player identification and record-count denominators on attribute snapshots.

name: Player Attributes Row Identifier
definition: The surrogate row identifier of one player attribute snapshot row; it identifies the snapshot row itself, not the player.
scope: Addressing a single attribute snapshot row when a question cites a bare numeric identifier together with an attribute value.

name: Home Team Goals
definition: The number of goals scored by the home team in a match.
scope: Home-side goal totals and per-match home goal averages.

name: Away Team Goals
definition: The number of goals scored by the away team in a match.
scope: Away-side goal totals and goal-difference or draw analysis.

name: Drawn Match
definition: A match in which both teams scored the same number of goals, so neither team won.
scope: Counting matches that ended as a draw within a league or season.

name: Height
definition: A player's physical height, recorded in centimetres on a metric scale.
scope: Physical-profile filtering of players, for example players under or above a height threshold.

name: Weight
definition: A player's body weight, recorded in pounds.
scope: Physical-profile ranking of players, such as finding the heaviest player.

name: Birthday
definition: A player's date of birth, recorded as a datetime value; a larger value corresponds to a more recent birth and therefore a younger player.
scope: Birth-year and birth-month filtering and age derivation.

name: Player Age
definition: A player's age at a chosen reference instant, obtained by comparing that instant with the player's date of birth.
scope: Age comparison and oldest/youngest ranking of players.

name: Overall Rating
definition: The composite performance rating of a player in a snapshot, on a roughly 0-100 scale; it is the headline overall quality measure of a player.
scope: Ranking and threshold filtering of players by overall quality.

name: Potential
definition: The projected maximum ability of a player in a snapshot; low values indicate players with the least projected growth.
scope: Ranking and threshold filtering of players by projected ability.

name: Heading Accuracy
definition: A skill score describing how accurate a player is when heading the ball.
scope: Player skill-score comparison and averaging.

name: Crossing
definition: A skill score describing how well a player delivers crosses.
scope: Player skill-score comparison and ranking.

name: Jumping
definition: A skill score describing a player's jumping ability.
scope: Player skill-score comparison between individual players.

name: Finishing
definition: A skill score describing how well a player finishes scoring chances.
scope: Player skill-score comparison.

name: Curve
definition: A skill score describing how much curve a player can put on the ball.
scope: Player skill-score comparison.

name: Long Shots
definition: A skill score describing a player's ability to shoot from long range.
scope: Player skill-score comparison and averaging.

name: Sprint Speed
definition: A skill score describing a player's top sprinting speed.
scope: Player skill-score threshold filtering.

name: Strength
definition: The physical strength skill score of a player. It is a separate skill measure from the composite overall rating even though both share a comparable numeric scale.
scope: Player skill-score comparison when the physical strength skill is meant.

name: Build Up Play Speed
definition: The speed at which a team builds up its attacks, on a roughly 0-100 style scale.
scope: Team playing-style ranking and comparison.
aliases: speed in which attacks are put together

name: Chance Creation Passing
definition: The chance creation through passing score of a team, on a roughly 0-100 style scale.
scope: Team playing-style ranking and comparison.

name: Build Up Play Speed Class
definition: The categorical band that summarises a team's build-up play speed score.
scope: Reading the categorical label attached to a build-up speed score.

name: Chance Creation Passing Class
definition: The categorical band that summarises a team's chance creation passing score, answering questions that ask what a score is classified as.
scope: Reading the categorical label attached to a chance creation passing score.

name: Average Player Attribute
definition: The average level of a player attribute across the qualifying attribute snapshot records, expressed as the summed attribute value divided by the number of attribute records considered.
scope: Averaging a player skill or rating across that player's attribute snapshots when a question asks for an average attribute value.
